image-generation.prompt-elaborate:
Cinematic close-up intimate scene. A 45-year-old Italian woman (use Elena reference) sits on a soft beige sofa in a warm living room in late afternoon light. She holds an iPhone in both hands, looking down at the screen with a soft contemplative expression - her thumb is hovering over the screen. The phone screen is partially visible: we see what appears to be a Photos app interface with a recent selfie thumbnail visible AND a "Delete" trash icon highlighted - she has just deleted a photo or is about to. The just-deleted photo on screen is intentionally blurred/pixelated so we cannot see the face clearly.
She wears a comfortable cream cardigan. Her hair is loose. The living room is warm and lived-in: a soft blanket draped on the sofa beside her, a small ceramic cup on the side table, golden afternoon light streaming from an unseen window on her left.
Photorealistic editorial cinematography, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field at f/2.0, sharp focus on her thumb hovering on screen + her face, natural skin texture, warm cinematic color grading. Color palette: warm cream, soft beige, gold light, hints of phone screen blue glow on her face.
Mood: private modern moment, quiet self-rejection acknowledged without drama. The kind of moment every modern woman has had alone with her phone.
CRITICAL: phone screen content (the deleted selfie) must be intentionally unrecognizable/blurred. Real woman skin on her face (no retouching). The "delete" gesture is implied, not theatrical. No tears, no drama.
image-generation.negative-prompt: cartoon, illustration, dramatic crying, theatrical sadness, before/after weight comparison, fitness model thin, instagram heavy filter, body shaming, harsh light, modern cold setting, photoshopped phone, makeup heavy, selfie clearly visible (must be blurred)

copy-for-meta-ads-manager.primary-text:
Quanti selfie hai cancellato questo mese?
Quanti ne hai scattati che non hai mai postato?
Quanti gruppi WhatsApp hai mutato per non vedere le foto delle altre in vacanza?
💜 Sei in buona compagnia. Le 2300+ donne del mio metodo hanno fatto tutte questa cosa, almeno per un periodo. Non perché siano vanitose. Perché c'è una distanza tra come si sentono dentro e come si vedono fuori — e quella distanza fa male, ogni giorno, in modo silenzioso.
In 3 sere live ti racconto come si chiude quella distanza. Non con un filtro. Non con una dieta. Con un METODO. 19, 20, 21 maggio 18:30. Gratis. 30 minuti l'una.
Non prometto miracoli. Prometto solo che il prossimo selfie potrai tenerlo.
🔥 100 posti.
Posto qui ↓

notes.note: Phone screen visibile MA selfie blurred/pixelated. Thumb hovering = gesto delete-implicit. Subtle blue glow del telefono sul viso = realismo digital. NO drama theatrical.

3 question stack ("selfie cancellati / selfie non postati / WhatsApp mutati") = self-recognition cumulativa. "Distanza tra come ti senti dentro e come ti vedi fuori" = framing brillante (universalize + non-pathologize). Promise concreta: "il prossimo selfie potrai tenerlo".
Format priority 9:16 (Reel/Story) per topic mobile-native. Highlight pink su "questo mese" = quantifica recency.
Audience digital-native 35-50. Aspettarsi alti share (universal modern pain). Topic-relevance fortissima per IG/Reels users.
Pain è digitale, non corporeo diretto. NO claim peso. Frame psicologico healthy ("distanza dentro/fuori"). Compliance Meta verde.
